description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Scion Sorceress], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark)] and [Night's Prayer Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Scion Sorceress
description.text: Black Magic and Witch abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Night's Prayer Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Night's Prayer (Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark) after using two Fire, Ice, Lightning or Dark abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark damage

description.name: Night's Prayer (Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)]/Causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)]/Causes [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)]/Causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Dark 10% (15s)]  to the user if the triggering ability cause Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark damage

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
